npcs.name: Tinker Ollo
dialog: Moving day, huh? Boot Harbor runs on two things: dock coffee and Mochiichao.
Tall grass is where wild ones hide. Weaken one first, THEN throw a Luigi Cube.
A cube thrown at a full-HP Mochiichao usually just bounces off.

npcs.name: Pip
dialog: Fire beats steel! My big sister says the Silicon Town dojo master uses a steel shell.
If I had a fire-type I'd go win that badge myself.
